name: Le Lavoir Limited
about: Le Lavoir Limited provides special consumer services in India. The company provides institutional laundry, dry cleaning, carpet cleaning, steam iron, shoes cleaning, and clothing alterations and repair services. It serves salons and spas, assisted living and nursing homes, restaurants and caterers, hotels and motels, religious organizations, nail salons, daycare centers, athletic facilities, and gyms. The company was formerly known as Radhey Trade Holding Limited and changed its name to Le Lavoir Limited in February 2021. Le Lavoir Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India.
